description: This file defines an abstract service interface for fetching matches and a mock implementation of that service for testing purposes within a dating app frontend.

classes.name: MatchService
classes.description: An abstract class that declares a method to fetch match items based on a query map.

classes.name: MockMatchService
classes.description: A mock implementation of MatchService that returns deterministic, canned match items for testing.

methods.name: fetchMatches
methods.description: Fetches a list of match items based on provided query parameters.
